Hello UMAIR,

We hope you are doing well.

We would like to check if you are interested in extending your stay with us. Please note that, for any extension, the rate will be different from your previous booking. There will be a 20% increase in the rate for the extension period.

We wanted to inform you in advance so you can plan accordingly.

Kindly let us know if you would like to proceed with the extension, and we will be happy to assist you.

Thank you.
